notes.title: Explosion experiments
notes.content: A new build was just released, where we have added a destruction system. Dynamites and a simple rocketlauncher are now available and the explosions can break objects as well as give impulses to the surrounding objects.

notes.title: Multiplayer released!
notes.content:
VR really shines as a social experience, so we've hastened development of the multiplayer support for Mekside and are now testing it in this Early Access release.

The currently deployed build of the game now features a "Connect to Server" option in the start menu, connecting you to our multiplayer server which is always running, simulating the physics, players and creatures inside it.

VR multiplayer in combination with the free building and physics is a really fun experience, and we will soon post some videos showcasing this!
